docs.title: ACR: Acquisition or Disposition of Shares of Another Corporation
docs.text:
Disposition of Shares Held by Alsons Consolidated Resources, Inc. (“ACR”) in Seafront Resources Corporation (“SPM”)

Seafront Resources Corporation (“SPM”) conducted a voluntary tender offer to acquire up to 34,580,000 common shares, representing 21.21% of the issued and outstanding shares of SPM, pursuant to Section 19 of the Securities Regulation Code.Alsons Consolidated Resources, Inc. (“ACR”), which owns 15,544,911 common shares of SPM, representing 9.54% of SPM’s issued and outstanding shares, elected to participate in the tender offer and applied to tender all of its shares to SPM at the tender offer price of Php 2.70 per share.The total transaction value amounts to Php 41,971,259.70.

The transaction forms part of ACR’s portfolio management strategy, allowing the Company to convert its investment in SPM into liquid funds. The proceeds from the disposition are expected to strengthen ACR’s liquidity position and may be redeployed to support other investments, capital requirements, and strategic initiatives of the Company.

Application to tender shares under the voluntary tender offer conducted by SPM.

Seafront Resources Corporation (“SPM”) was originally incorporated on April 16, 1970, as an oil exploration and production company. On October 18, 1996, the Company amended its primary purpose to become a holding company, with oil exploration and production retained as one of its secondary purposes.SPM also maintains a portfolio of investments consisting of stocks traded on the Philippine Stock Exchange and investments in government securities.

Cash, to be remitted through bank transfer.

Tender offer price as determined and offered by SPM under the voluntary tender offer.

Payment shall be made on the settlement date of March 12, 2026.

Completion of the tender offer process and compliance with applicable tender offer requirements and procedures.

N.A.

The transaction is expected to have no material adverse effect on the business and operations of ACR. The proceeds from the disposition will increase the Company’s cash position and may be utilized for general corporate purposes and future investment opportunities.
